title: Final impact speed
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives the magnitude of the impact velocity as √(2gL sinθ).

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem correctly from the initial release to the ground impact.

title: Projectile launch velocity
description: Important: Correctly finds the horizontal launch speed from the arc end using energy for a given radius.

title: Projectile time of flight
description: Important: Correctly calculates the free-fall time from the arc end to the inclined plane.

title: Angle for maximum range
description: Essential: Correctly identifies the inclination angle θ = 90° that maximizes the horizontal distance in part (3).

title: Impact angle tangent
description: Important: Correctly computes tan(α) = v_horizontal / v_vertical for the given numerical conditions in part (2).

title: Distance to point O
description: Important: Correctly calculates the distance from the landing point to point O using geometry for part (2).

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in kinematic equations or omits units in final answers where required.

title: Trigonometric confusion
description: Pitfall: Misidentifies the sides or angles when relating the impact velocity components or the geometry of the landing point.

title: Range maximization reasoning
description: Optional: Provides clear reasoning (e.g., derivative analysis) for why the horizontal distance is maximized at θ = 90° in part (3).
